svg.text: • Shell: arc R108 (inside) / R111, from −15° to 55° around the flywheel axis, 94 wide
• Two side lips 3 thick, R100 … R108, flush with the shell ends
• Lip holes Ø3.3 at R104, at 0° and 45° (M3 screw + nut to the bracket)
• Angles from the flywheel axis: 0° = forward, positive = up
• Small numbers at the edges of the Front view: hole positions from the corner marked 0
